title: Law to pilot matching small businesses with content creators
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a one-year pilot program matching small businesses with social media content creators for marketing help. It sets out application requirements for both businesses and creators and requires SBS to notify participants of matches within 30 days after enrollment closes. The department must report to the mayor and Council speaker on the program's results, and the law would expire three years after enactment.
